analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong first quarter for fiscal 2027, with total revenue from operations reaching INR 121 crores, representing a 60% year-on-year growth. EBITDA came in at INR 18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%, while profit after tax stood at INR 9 crores or 7.5% of revenue. The company is actively executing its retail expansion plans with upcoming store launches in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar across the second and third quarters of fiscal 2027. Management highlighted a strategic transition towards increasing retail revenue contribution, improving asset turns, and gradually utilizing Gold Metal Loans for hedging and leveraging. RBZ Jewellers reported a 60% year-on-year revenue increase in Q1FY27, driven by strong customer demand and brand recall.

guidance.claim: The company delivered revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve full utilization of its current manufacturing capacity by the end of FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that IIJS generated warm and encouraging responses with good buyer growth and order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in the first quarter was supported by strong customer demand and improved brand recognition.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat store will be launched in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: Okay. So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Maninagar and Gandhinagar stores will both be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in small format stores is around INR 50 crores, plus and minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex break-even for the stores will be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is opening flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot during the second and third quarters respectively.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter is INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores, translating PAT at 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Amortization of lease assets stands at INR 76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the financial year 2026 improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: The factory utilization is currently running at around 50% of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Job work services represented 52% of the total gold volumes sold during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Accounted for 52% of total gold volumes sold in FY26, highlighting its strategic importance to the business.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds roughly a 1% share of the organized wholesale gold jewellery market in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Command approximately 1% share of India's organized wholesale gold jewellery market.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is yet to be fully utilized.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes an asset-light model for its job work segment by using gold supplied by customers.
capital_allocation.quote: Enables an asset-light business model by minimizing investment in gold inventory while supporting demand fulfillment.

management_commitments.claim: By the end of the current financial year, the debt to equity ratio will still remain below 1:1 at around 0.8 to 1.
management_commitments.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

management_commitments.claim: By the end of this year, at least 20% of corporate sales mix will be of 18 caratage.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching maximum utilization of its manufacturing capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a flagship showroom in Surat.
management_commitments.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2)

management_commitments.claim: Showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
